regulation_name: Decennial Census of the Population of Americans; Proposed Residence Criteria and Proposed Regulations for Demographic Questions
brief_description: Census Bureau NPRM (RIN 0607-AA75) establishing 15 CFR Part 60 (residence criteria for the decennial census, including a Jan 3-Apr 1 usual-residence window and exclusion of persons without lawful status from the apportionment count) and 15 CFR Part 70 (restrictions barring race, ethnicity, and sexual-orientation questions from the decennial questionnaire). Comments close 2026-10-14.
